info.title: dvspec
info.description: Offline-first declarative schema planning and application for Microsoft Dataverse.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: dvspec — apply sparse, declarative schema changes to a Microsoft Dataverse solution.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --env
options.description: Optional appsettings environment (loads appsettings.<env>.json, e.g. dev or test).

options.name: --profile
options.description: Deprecated alias for --env. --env wins if both are given.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Emit verbose diagnostics. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute and report actions without writing to Dataverse. [default: False]

options.name: --solution
options.description: Unique name of the target unmanaged solution.

options.name: --prefix
options.description: Publisher prefix (2–8 alphanumerics, starts with a letter, not 'mscrm').

options.name: --language
options.description: Default LCID for labels (default 1033). [default: 1033]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Lint a spec (parse, resolve, validate) without touching the environment.

options.name: --spec
options.description: Path to the spec file (YAML or JSON). Defaults to spec.yaml/spec.yml/spec.json in the current directory.

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Resolve and normalize a spec entirely offline for downstream tooling.

options.name: --spec
options.description: Path to a YAML or JSON spec.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit only the versioned resolved-schema JSON contract to stdout. [default: False]

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Dump a live table's resolved definition (columns, choices, relationships).

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the machine-readable table definition (for agent consumption) instead of a human summary. [default: False]

arguments.name: TABLE
arguments.description: Logical name of the table to describe (e.g. 'account' or 'dvst_project').

commands.name: fetch
commands.description: Refresh cached table definitions and re-capture the drift baseline.

options.name: --tables
options.description: Comma-separated table logical names to fetch (e.g. account,dvst_project). Defaults to the spec's tables.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit a machine-readable summary of what was cached instead of a human summary. [default: False]

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Compute the sparse change plan (diff spec vs live) and persist it.

options.name: --spec
options.description: Path to the spec file (YAML or JSON). Defaults to spec.yaml/spec.yml/spec.json in the current directory.

options.name: --watch
options.description: Re-plan on spec changes and launch the localhost preview (Phase 11 live view). [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the machine-readable plan (Phase 5 schema) instead of a human summary. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-destroy
options.description: Reserved for destructive apply; currently rejected rather than generating an unexecutable plan. [default: False]

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply the plan after re-checking drift against the persisted baseline.

options.name: --spec
options.description: Path to the spec file (YAML or JSON). Defaults to spec.yaml/spec.yml/spec.json in the current directory.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the interactive confirmation prompt (non-interactive/CI apply). [default: False]

options.name: --allow-destroy
options.description: Reserved for destructive apply; currently rejected rather than executing an unsafe partial implementation. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit a machine-readable result (including a drift report) instead of a human summary. [default: False]

commands.name: rebase
commands.description: Accept current live state as the new baseline, then re-plan.

options.name: --spec
options.description: Path to the spec file (YAML or JSON). Defaults to spec.yaml/spec.yml/spec.json in the current directory.

options.name: --allow-destroy
options.description: Reserved for destructive apply; currently rejected during re-planning. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the machine-readable re-planned plan (Phase 5 schema) instead of a human summary. [default: False]

commands.name: preview
commands.description: Serve a localhost live view of the plan; re-plans on spec save (SSE).

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port for the live-view host (default 5787). [default: 5787]

options.name: --allow-apply
options.description: Surface an apply button in the preview (off by default; the CLI is the primary apply path). [default: False]

options.name: --spec
options.description: Path to the spec file (YAML or JSON). Defaults to spec.yaml/spec.yml/spec.json in the current directory.
